Turns "possessiveness, jealousy, clinginess, suspicion" into a **self-evolving state** rather than a persona label. Off by default; when on it is driven by real interaction — your messages, reply speed, days of silence, whether you mention someone else, sleep — and interacts with depression. However severe, extreme severity (≥0.85) automatically enters the safety layer: only expressing emotion and asking for company, not generating methods of self-harm or harm.

How to configure: ① turn on the switch and pick a type (exclusive / dependent / delusional / monitoring / self-harm / excluding) — the type only changes "the weight of the same drive", not hard-coded lines; or ② write keywords directly in the persona and the system enables it automatically and fills initial values from the persona: e.g. "strongly possessive, easily jealous"→exclusive, "very clingy, cannot live without you"→dependent, "always checking up, following"→monitoring, "paranoid, always feeling deceived"→delusional. To better match "yandere often comes with depression", set the "emotion-regulation profile" above to depression; the two aggravate each other.

Turns the "personality label" into a dynamical system in parameter space: slow-varying persona parameters θ (12 groups / 69 dimensions: Big Five, HEXACO, attachment, temperament, regulation, dark, motivation, cognition, relationship, value, clinical, expression) + fast-varying desire vector D (16 dims) + emotion state x (16 dims) + mode state machine T + gender/social-script parameter group G + learning/development operator L. Off by default; when on it is driven by real interaction and three modes emerge naturally: **normal is a stable attractor** (falls back to baseline exponentially after perturbation), **tsundere is the filtered state of "high affection × high suppression"**, **yandere is the positive feedback of "high possession × high anxiety × low trust × low self-control"** — and tsundere→yandere is an observable, testable, almost-irreversible (sensitisation lag) phase transition. Readiness ≥0.85 automatically enters the safety layer.

The type library has 187 regions in total (attachment 12 · Big Five/HEXACO combinations · clinical simulation 16 · Enneagram 9 · MBTI 16 auto-derived · DISC 4 · social roles 13 · motives 11 · cognitive styles 13 · ACG female/neutral 16 · male archetypes 77 + classics 18). **A type is just a region in parameter space, not hard-coded lines**: define (θ, D⁰, x_eq, w, g, T, A) to add a new one. Clinical-simulation types (borderline / narcissistic / depressive…) only make abstract labels and are **forbidden to deploy** — the panel will not give concrete methods. The "gender/social script" is G=(M,F,GRC,EM,DR,AR,SR,SC,HS): it changes expression gain g, threat signal s, self-control K, empathy C, help-seeking tendency and decision utility R_G(a); when "Unspecified" is chosen all formulas are exactly the same as without a script.

How to configure: ① turn on the switch and pick an archetype — the archetype only changes parameters, not hard-coded lines; or ② write keywords directly in the persona and the system enables it automatically and fills initial values from the persona: e.g. "sharp-tongued but actually very clingy"→tsundere, "yandere, extremely possessive"→yandere, "CEO, never takes no for an answer"→CEO tyrant (automatically applies the "high-traditional male" script). It can be on at the same time as "Tsundere / yandere dynamics": the latter is a three-variable sketch, the former is the full θ/D/x/f/g/T/G/L framework, and the two do not conflict.

Turns "sharp-tongued on the surface, gentle inside" and "obsession in the name of love" into the same **self-evolving three-variable system** (affection A / tsundere expression T / yandere fixation Y). Off by default; when on it is driven by real interaction — the warmth of your messages, reply speed, days of silence, whether you mention someone else — and yandere-ification is reversible: stop the cold treatment and keep caring and it returns to tsundere. Extreme severity (≥0.85) automatically enters the safety layer.

How to configure: ① turn on the switch and pick a type (classic / aloof / hot-tempered / indulgent) — the type only changes "the weight of the same drive" (how fast it darkens, how stubborn the mouth), not hard-coded lines; or ② write keywords directly in the persona and the system enables it automatically and fills initial values from the persona: e.g. "tsundere, stubborn"→classic, "aloof, iceberg"→aloof, "explodes at a touch, hot-tempered"→hot-tempered, "good-natured, awkwardly caring"→indulgent. If the persona also says "yandere / possessive", it is recommended to also enable "pathological attachment" above; the two affect each other.

The published formalisation of 柳・米澤 (2023): the internal state is a point on Russell's affect circumplex, and affection A drives a superlinear reaction gain — the same event moves a deeply-attached heart far more violently — plus a superlinear expression intensity. NORMAL / DERE / YAMI switch with hysteresis, so a blackened character does not snap back on the first kind word. Off by default; driven by real interaction (warmth, reply delay, silence, mentions of someone else).

How to configure: turn on the switch and pick an archetype (yandere / tsundere / neutral / tsundere→yandere), or write the keywords in the persona ("yandere, possessive" / "tsundere") and the circuit turns on with its initial values filled from the persona. Independent of the tsundere ODE and the full persona-dynamics framework; extreme darkness (≥0.70) enters the safety layer.
